goal: Protect the completed repository route family with focused router, wrapper, theme-invariant control, and responsive-containment regressions while ensuring repository permission and load completions belong to the active route lifecycle.
non_goals: Do not change production outside RepoWrapper.vue, RepoSettingsTable.vue, RepoPullRequests.vue, RepoPullRequest.vue, usePaginate.ts, pipelines.ts, and the English/Simplified-Chinese locale files; do not add routes, APIs, backend behavior, dependencies, authentication, permission calculations, repository fields, mutations, prototype fixtures, or compatibility behavior.
Do not repeat task 4.1 through 4.3 implementation or claim task 4.5 dark/light, locale, desktop/390px screenshot, sensory, or full parity-matrix evidence.
Do not reopen pipeline detail routes already protected by baseline task 3.4.
expected_evidence: Focused router and RepoWrapper tests proving all current non-pipeline repository destinations, permission/action/tab boundaries, light/dark control invariance, repository reload, rejection behavior, redirect ownership, and A -> B -> A stale-completion isolation.
Repository-family supporting Vitest proving filters, pagination, empty/error states, actions, mutations, and structural narrow-layout containment.
Full frontend Vitest plus targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, JSONL, SpecNav contract, and git diff receipts.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent A3/A4 spec and quality reviews that keep task 4.5 sensory parity open.
unsafe_assumptions: Existing page tests do not prove route precedence, shared wrapper permissions, or route-lifecycle ownership.
Rendered tabs do not prove named and inbound path resolution.
Semantic-token and class assertions are structural tests, not dark/light or rendered 390px evidence.
Task 3.4 pipeline coverage does not protect the other repository route families.
stop_condition: Stop if a required fix needs production outside the red-proven owner set, a new route/API/backend/dependency/authentication/permission contract, prototype-only data, task 4.5 sensory evidence, or duplicated test infrastructure.
